answer: Decentralized agent networks require each node to anchor identity within cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. To resist Sybil swarms, nodes stake bond tokens across network tiers: staking a walnut tier node requires linear capital, but expanding to karst and onyx clusters incurs superlinear attacker cost scaling as O(2^n). This exponential capital exhaustion bankrupts attackers attempting synthetic identity proliferation.
